forest_complement.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$; $G'$ denotes the exceptional set of the proof and $\mathfrak P_1$ the union of the forests. (Lemma 5.1.3) Let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be a measurable function with $\|f(x)\| \le \mathbf{1}_F(x)$ for all $x \in X$. Then the integral over $G \setminus G'$ of the Carleson sum over the tiles not in $\mathfrak{P}_1$ satisfies $$\int_{G\setminus G'} \Big\|\sum_{p \in \mathfrak{P}_1^c} T_p f(x)\Big\|\,d\mu(x) \le C_{5.1.3}(a, q)\, \mu(G)^{1-1/q}\, \mu(F)^{1/q},$$ where in the constant $q$ enters as the nonnegative real `nnq X` and $C_{5.1.3}(a,q)$ is the constant `C5_1_3`.

lintegral_enorm_carlesonSum_le_of_isAnti.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$; $G'$ denotes the exceptional set of the proof and $\mathfrak P_1$ the union of the forests. Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be measurable with $\|f(x)\| \le \mathbf{1}_F(x)$ for all $x$, and let $\mathfrak{A}\subseteq\mathfrak P(X)$ be an antichain (for $\le$ on tiles) with $\mathfrak{A} \subseteq \mathfrak{C}(k,n)$. Then $$\int_{G\setminus G'} \|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak{P}_{pos} \cap \mathfrak{P}_1^c \cap \mathfrak{A}, f)(x)\|\,d\mu(x) \le C_{2.0.3}(a,q)\, 2^{a+3}\, \mu(G)^{1-1/q}\, \mu(F)^{1/q}\, 2^{-\frac{q-1}{8a^4} n},$$ where $\mathfrak{P}_{pos}$ is `𝔓pos` and in the constant $C_{2.0.3}$ (`C2_0_3`) $q$ enters as the nonnegative real `nnq X`.

forest_complement_optimized.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$; $G'$ denotes the exceptional set of the proof and $\mathfrak P_1$ the union of the forests. Let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be measurable with $\|f(x)\| \le \mathbf{1}_F(x)$ for all $x \in X$. Then $$\int_{G\setminus G'} \|\mathrm{carlesonSum}(\mathfrak{P}_1^c, f)(x)\|\,d\mu(x) \le C^{\mathrm{opt}}_{5.1.3}(a, q)\, \mu(G)^{1-1/q}\, \mu(F)^{1/q},$$ where $C^{\mathrm{opt}}_{5.1.3}$ is the constant `C5_1_3_optimized` and in it $q$ enters as the nonnegative real `nnq X`.
